title: Standings/statistics can double-count overlapping Brasileirão seasons
evidence: Sources/BrazilianSoccerMCP/SoccerStore.swift:8,12 load both Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv under competition "Brasileirão"; standings() (line 104) and statistics() (line 111) filter by normalized competition contains, so a season present in both CSVs is counted twice (teams can exceed 38 games). No dedup across sources.
suggestion: Deduplicate matches across source CSVs (by date+teams+score) or scope each competition to a single authoritative dataset before aggregating.

title: JSON-RPC dispatch and several tools are untested
evidence: Tests/BrazilianSoccerMCPTests/SoccerStoreTests.swift exercises CSV.parse, normalized, findMatches, teamRecord, standings, statistics only; handle()/tools dispatch in main.swift:21-44, searchPlayers (SoccerStore.swift:99) and headToHead (SoccerStore.swift:93) have no test coverage.
suggestion: Add a test that drives handle()/tools-call for head_to_head and search_players so the MCP surface is exercised, not just the store internals.

title: Tests use synthetic fixtures only; shipped data/kaggle CSVs never loaded in tests
evidence: SoccerStoreTests.swift:5-9 writes temp fixtures for every test; the real data/kaggle/*.csv header mappings (SoccerStore.swift:8-16) are verified only at runtime, not in the suite.
suggestion: Add a smoke test that loads data/kaggle (guarded if absent) and asserts non-zero matches/players to catch header drift.

title: Dependency-free hand-rolled MCP (no official SDK)
evidence: Package.swift declares zero dependencies; main.swift:46-68 implements JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio directly (initialize/tools/list/tools/call/ping). Protocol-conformant but not SDK-backed.
suggestion: None required; noted for cross-run comparison with SDK-based implementations.

title: Accent/suffix/alias normalizer with Atletico-PR vs Atletico-MG disambiguation
evidence: SoccerStore.swift:40-62 folds diacritics, strips state suffixes, and canonicalizes club aliases, preserving the Paranaense state clue; covered by testNormalizationHandlesAccentsAndStateSuffixes (SoccerStoreTests.swift:14-18).
suggestion: None; surfaced as a strength beyond spec.
